title: Theron's Vote Count
description: Theron has completed his headcount. The constitutional text doesn't have the parliamentary votes it needs. He's come with a specific proposal: two provisions that could be adjusted to bring in the missing bloc. He wants to discuss it before it becomes formal.

title: Constitutional Draft — Committee Markup
description: The working committees are marking up the draft. Every article is being contested. The provision on executive powers is generating the most heat. This is where the document takes its final shape.

title: Budget Allocation — Mid-Convention Review
description: The convention is consuming resources faster than projected. Vostane needs adjustments to the fiscal framework before the numbers become public.

title: Kolvar's Signals
description: Kolvar's parliamentary assistants have been approaching reformist backbenchers in the tea room. Not threatening — inquiring. He's building something. Vyktor thinks you should hear what's being offered before responding.

title: Eastern Border — Refugee Assessment
description: The Interior Ministry reports a sharp increase in border crossings from eastern Morivask. The numbers are still manageable. The trend line is not. The Dravenni deputies will raise this in convention.

title: The Petition from Dravenhollow
description: A delegation asks the state to finally enforce the 1947 minorities charter's language rights. Archbishop Renek warns the Church will withdraw its 112 Dravenhollow schools if it happens.

title: The Factory Floor
description: Serida stays late, organizing tomorrow's briefing. Tomas came home today with news about the Kravenstal foundry's modernization plan.

title: The Committee Vote
description: The drafting committee is ready to vote on the constitutional framework.
